subject: MAP ignition: kickoff, roles & 8-week close runway (Hexagen)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@hexagen.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP ignition: kickoff, roles & 8-week close runway (Hexagen)

Alex —

Really pleased we could connect last week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to align on stakeholders, success criteria and a practical 8-week evaluation + close runway for Hexagen's pilot of Redwood inference. Goal here is to make the next steps explicit so we have no surprises for procurement or security.

High-level proposal (8-week runway):
- Week 0 (this week): MAP kickoff, access & baseline data collection
- Weeks 1–3: Integration + model eval (sample workloads, latency/cost monitoring)
- Week 4: Internal results review & quality check with Hexagen champion
- Weeks 5–6: Final tuning + paperwork (SOW / security evidence)
- Week 7–8: Exec review & close / go/no-go decision

Owners I propose:
- Hexagen champion: Alex Kim (your side)
- Redwood AE / map lead: Priya Natarajan (me)
- Redwood solutions & ops: Evelyn Hart (technical onboarding), Jonas Weber (SLA & billing)

Immediate asks for this week:
1) Can you confirm the primary champion and any additional stakeholders who should be on weekly 30-min syncs?
2) Please share the sample dataset/workload representative of production (or a short sample) and the expected success metrics (latency P50/P95 targets, accuracy/quality notes).
3) Any procurement constraints or security questionnaire deadlines we should be aware of?

Attaching a lightweight MAP template (MAP-template-hexagen.xlsx) and a first-pass SOW for transparency (SOW-draft-v1.pdf). I kept the MAP intentionally simple — we can expand the milestones after your feedback.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-30m call if easier.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@hexagen.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samira Ortiz <samira.ortiz@hexagen.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP ignition: kickoff, roles & 8-week close runway (Hexagen)

Priya —

Thanks for the clear note and the template — this is exactly what we need. Confirming I will be the champion and Samira (Head of ML Prod) should be included on technical syncs. A couple of quick items:

- Stakeholders: Alex Kim (Champion), Samira Ortiz (ML Prod), Kevin Park (Security — may join as needed)
- Success metrics: P50 latency < 150ms, P95 < 350ms on our standard 512-token prompt, and embeddings accuracy comparable to our current baseline (we'll share the A/B prompts)
- Procurement: We're aiming to complete legal & PO within 6–7 weeks; Kevin will need SOC2 artifacts by week 3 for initial review.

I can share a sanitized sample workload by EOD tomorrow. Weekly 30m syncs on Thursdays at 11am PT work for us — can Priya/Evelyn confirm?

Quick question — is there a non-prod environment we can use for the first 2 weeks with token limits so we don't hit production costs while testing?

Appreciate the SOW draft.

Best,
Alex
Senior Platform Engineer (Champion)
Hexagen
alex.kim@hexagen.com

Subject: Re: MAP ignition: kickoff, roles & 8-week close runway (Hexagen)

Thanks Priya & Alex —

Appreciate the clear runway. A couple of operational notes from the onboarding side:

- Non-prod sandbox: We can provision a sandbox project in our dedicated staging cluster with a token cap and reduced throughput for the first 2 weeks. I'll coordinate the billing/scoping with Jonas.
- Security artifacts: I'll assemble the SOC2 summary and a short data flow diagram for Kevin to review by day 10. If Hexagen needs our encryption KMS details or DSAR handling, let me know specifics.
- Integration checklist: I'll send a short checklist (API keys, VPC peering options, sample request/response formats) — can we get the sample prompts/data to validate against the checklist by Wed EOD?

If Alex confirms the Thurs 11am PT recurring, I'll put the invite on the calendar and include a 30m agenda: sync objectives / integration blockers / deliverables for the week.

Evelyn Hart
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Alex / team —

Thanks for the quick confirmations — this is great. Plan of record:
- Recurring: Thursdays 11:00am–11:30am PT starting 2027-08-19 (I'll send calendar invite)
- Sandbox provision: Evelyn will provision staging with token cap (first 2 weeks)
- Security: Evelyn to share SOC2 summary and data flow by 2027-08-25
- Sample workload: Alex to share sanitized sample by 2027-08-17 EOD
- Procurement: Jonas will provide a short procurement timeline and order-of-operations for PO/SOW by next sync

Next steps (this week):
- Alex: share sample workload and champion contact list (Samira / Kevin)
- Evelyn: provisioning checklist and SOC2 summary link
- Jonas: initial procurement checklist and a point of contact for PO processing
- Priya: send calendar invite + attach final MAP template (attached)

If anything shifts on timing please flag in the thread. Looking forward to getting you provisioned and running tests.

Best,
